*Create actionable GitHub issues that issueflow can take through planning and implementation.*

> **Never present an issue as ready for implementation when its desired outcome, scope, or testable acceptance criteria remain unresolved.**

## Why install this

Issueflow can plan faster when the issue already explains the problem, the intended outcome and how to verify success. Issuecreator researches the repository, writes that brief, and publishes it when requested.

It calls out consequential unknowns and preserves the boundary between observed facts and suggested implementation approaches.

## What you get

| Path | What it provides |
|---|---|
| `skills/issuecreator/SKILL.md` | What the agent reads: triggers, the flow, and the one rule. |
| `skills/issuecreator/scripts/` | The deterministic half — `validate`, `render`, `create`. |
| `skills/issuecreator/references/issue-format.md` | Issue body contract: problem and impact; desired behavior; in-scope and out-of-scope work; verified repository context; acceptance checklist; verification plan; dependencies and consequential open questions. Bug issues additionally include reproduction, expected/actual behavior and available environment details. Respect repository issue templates and avoid invented evidence.. |
| `skills/issuecreator/skill-invariants.json` | The prose guardrails and the baseline eval declaration. |

## Quick start

Claude Code — run in chat:

```text
/plugin marketplace add natejswenson/claude-skills
/plugin install issuecreator@claude-skills
/issuecreator
```

Codex — run in a terminal from the root of this repository checkout:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add "$PWD"
codex plugin add issuecreator@claude-skills
```

Start a new Codex session, then invoke in chat:

```text
$issuecreator
```

For example, ask: “Create an issue for issueflow to handle empty repository selections.” Add “draft only” to keep the result local.

The bundled CLI can also process a JSON draft; see [the input contract](skills/issuecreator/references/issue-format.md):

```bash
node skills/issuecreator/scripts/issuecreator.js validate --input draft.json
node skills/issuecreator/scripts/issuecreator.js render --input draft.json --out ./draft-output
node skills/issuecreator/scripts/issuecreator.js create --input draft.json --repo OWNER/REPO --out ./publication-output
```

Creation publishes immediately and requires prior authorization. It records a durable receipt and verifies the remote title/body; an uncertain result stops instead of automatically retrying.

## Triggers

- "create an issue"
- "turn this into a GitHub issue"
- "write an issue for issueflow"
- "break this work into issues"
- Anything the method in `SKILL.md` covers, whether or not it is phrased that way.

## Requirements

- Node.js 18+; no npm dependencies.
- Authenticated GitHub CLI (`gh`) for remote research and publication.
- **Claude Code:** Allow local file and shell tools for the bundled commands.
- **Codex:** Allow the same local tools; authenticate `gh` in the Codex environment.
- **Personal data:** No private configuration store; receipts stay in the chosen output directory.

See [Codex migration notes](https://github.com/natejswenson/claude-skills/blob/main/docs/codex-migration.md) for host setup.

Local drafting needs neither authentication nor issueflow installed. Issueflow handoff is an optional next step. Publication receipts stay in the chosen output directory; no credentials are bundled or copied into the plugin.

## Development

```bash
cd skills/issuecreator/skills/issuecreator
npm test
```

Node skill. `ci / issuecreator` runs the same tests plus the house lints on
every pull request, and `skillfactory verify --skill issuecreator` reports which rung
of the ladder it has reached.
